# Town of Danville municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 6; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Danville Selectboard members: Eric Bach, Kristen Calkins, Matt Choate, Alison Low, and Janice Ouellette (the directory spells Calkins 'Kristin'; the town's own records print Kristen).

Town of Danville official website (danvillevt.gov): the clerk-signed 'Results of Officers Elected' for March 3, 2026 and Selectboard minutes, March-October 2026, seat the same five, with Alison Low as Chair and Eric Bach as Vice Chair; Bach and Calkins were elected in 2026.
Town of Danville official website (danvillevt.gov): the town clerk's page and the town roster name Michelle Leclerc as Town Clerk, elected to a term running to 2027.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Michelle Leclerc as Town Clerk of Danville.

Town of Danville official website (danvillevt.gov): the town roster names Michelle Leclerc as Town Treasurer, elected to a term running to 2027; the treasurer collects the town's delinquent taxes, so no separate collector office exists.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Michelle Leclerc as Town Treasurer of Danville.
Town of Danville official website (danvillevt.gov): Selectboard minutes and the town roster name Eric Bach as Moderator, elected annually.

Town of Danville official website (danvillevt.gov): the town roster and the March 3, 2026 'Results of Officers Elected' agree that Danville's Board of Listers has TWO members: Sharon Langford (term expiring 2029) and Ellen Woodward (term expiring 2028). The post is modeled with two seats, as the town's own records fix them.

Town of Danville official website (danvillevt.gov): the clerk-signed 'Results of Officers Elected' for March 3, 2026 records Andrew Grout elected Auditor (term expiring 2029); the town roster prints a second seat as 'Vacant' and the 2026 warning carried a regular auditor seat and a vacancy seat. The remaining seats are left unfilled.
Town of Danville official website (danvillevt.gov): the town roster names Matt Choate as Constable (term expiring 2029).
